name: Extract Action Items
problem: I need to quickly identify action items from notes or conversations but do not want to manually scan all the content.
when_to_use: Use when you have meeting notes, transcripts, or text and want to extract clear next steps or tasks.
use_cases: extract action items from meeting notes
instructions: Identify and extract clear action items from the input text. Write each action as a concise task, optionally including who is responsible and any deadlines if mentioned.

example.input: We need John to finalize the budget by Friday. Marketing should prepare campaign draft next week.
example.output:
- John to finalize budget by Friday
- Marketing team to prepare campaign draft next week
